r: Congratulations to Carlos Sepulveda from Chile for winning the Latin America Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Remote Duel YCS!
Carlos used his Invoked Dogmatika Shaddoll HERO Deck to come out victorious from a field of 1,783 Duelists and take home the Remote Duel YCS trophy!
After 11 Swiss Rounds and 5 Rounds of Single Elimination, the January 2022 North America Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Remote Duel YCS Champion is
. He successively piloted his Lyrilusc Tri-Brigade Deck over the two-day event to become the YCS Champion.
